Mise recipes

Reliable recipes for ordinary days—collected, cooked, and worth making again.

  • Creamy lemon pasta — Silky, bright, and ready in the time it takes to boil the pasta.

  • Crispy chickpea bowls — Roasted chickpeas, crunchy vegetables, and a punchy tahini dressing.

  • Overnight cinnamon oats — A softly spiced breakfast you can make before bed.
